info.title: NAP Store API
info.description: NAP Store platform API. Machine error codes are stable; messages are localized (ru/en). Mutating requests with duplicate risk accept an Idempotency-Key header.

delete.description: Anonymize the profile; financial journal and orders are kept (no cascading deletes).

get.description: Public, explicitly published fragment (<= 30 s) — never the full delivery file.

put.description: Withdraw from / return to new sales. Existing paid libraries are NOT affected.

post.description: Explicitly publish the <=30 s preview of one completed conversion as the public fragment.

TEST MODE ONLY. The redirect does not confirm payment: this emits signed provider webhooks that go through
the same verification/inbox path as a real provider.
Split the hardware cart into independent orders (one seller + warehouse + currency each).
Signed links are short-lived; an expired link requires a fresh, re-authorized grant.
Editing a profile always creates a new version; arbitrary DSP code/filters are never accepted.
Restricting already-paid access is a separate, audited action (not a side effect of withdrawal).
